### Actions

**Multiattack**. The charger makes two Gore attacks.

**Gore**. *Melee Attack Roll*: +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit*: 9 (2d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage. If it moved 20+ feet first, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Piercing damage.
